g.text: Historical comparison using attachment-aware, surviving-bond graphs
Same initial geometry and C1 artificial load. Original historical run: 217 nodes / 208 components; corrected native run: 199 / 190.
New bulk and interface softening laws, interface onset rounding (+1 ppm), event integration and MPI layout differ.
Exploratory comparison only; changes cannot be attributed solely to bulk softening. All three windows end at 2.33 ms.
